summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The KraneShares California Carbon Allowance Strategy ETF (KCCA) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Carbon Credit CCA index. The fund tracks an index of CCA carbon credit futures. The index holds futures that mature in December of the next one or two years KCCA was launched on Oct 5, 2021 and is issued by KraneShares.
